note: §6.4 figure-number pattern list, authored once at Phase 0 per source language. Each pattern is a Python regex; group 'n' captures the figure number (arabic, roman, or CJK numerals). Matching is case-insensitive. Changing this file requires a new version string.

zh: 第\s*(?P<n>[0-9一二三四五六七八九十百]+)\s*[圖图]
[圖图]\s*(?P<n>[0-9一二三四五六七八九十百]+)
ja: 第\s*(?P<n>[0-9一二三四五六七八九十百]+)\s*[圖図]
[圖図]\s*(?P<n>[0-9一二三四五六七八九十百]+)
